# PanePeek review standards

The paper trail owns project requirements. Apply these rules to changed behaviour; flag source conflicts. Use `.github/instructions/code-review.instructions.md` for investigation and comment style.

## Review rules

- **Product boundary:** Keep the native app macOS 26+ and local-only. Copy rejects name collisions; Move uses the separately gated Keep Both/Cancel and regular-file Replace choices, preserving captured identities, batch decisions and affected source/destination drafts. Deletion uses Trash without permanent fallback. Flag violations in implemented operations, not missing future tasks. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/0001-product-boundaries.md), [accepted collision policy](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-16-browser-ui-and-preview-improvements.md#changed-2026-10-16-move-collision-choices).
- **Foundation:** Preserve the Swift package/native app foundation and single deployment-target owner. Revisit it through a decision when an integration limitation requires change. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/0004-swift-package-application.md).
- **Navigation:** Resolve directory links to canonical locations off the UI thread; only the latest successful read replaces the location/listing. Keep selected-item link identity for metadata and copied paths. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/0005-finder-directory-symlink-navigation.md).
- **Sorting:** Name keeps folders first; Modified sorts all kinds by actual date, with unknowns last in either direction. Size compares metadata byte counts numerically, initially largest first, with unknown/directory/package/link sizes last in either direction and ascending natural-name/path ties. Preserve selected URLs and pane independence. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-11-modified-sort-policy.md), [Size ordering](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-16-browser-ui-and-preview-improvements.md#changed-2026-10-17-size-ordering).
- **Preview and Save:** Keep text reads bounded to 1 MiB/UTF-8, links read-only for editing, drafts intact on rejected transitions/save failures, and conflict checks before atomic replacement. Preserve BOM, newline sequences and permissions. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#details-sidebar-and-preview-editor).
- **Favourites:** Retain unavailable saved paths and surface navigation errors. The toolbar popover and menu-bar menu must allow explicit removal without opening the path or changing panes/drafts; repeated removal cannot re-add it. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#favourites-and-context-menus).
- **Creation:** Validate the literal filename and create exclusively, including collisions with broken links. Capture the creating pane/directory, guard replaced drafts and refresh affected panes. Successful dot-prefixed creation enables hidden visibility only in the creating pane. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#file-management).
- **Rename:** Keep single-item inline row editing and the shared context/File action. Browser Return begins rename; field Return submits and Escape cancels/restores list focus. Select the basename while retaining editable extensions, and select directory names/extensionless dotfiles whole. Double-click opens inline rename for files/packages/file links and navigates folders/directory links; Command-Down opens directories. A rejected selection must not retarget rename to the old item. Preserve local text-editor keys, collision checks and affected-draft safeguards. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-12-inline-rename-and-browser-keyboard.md), [file activation](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-12-file-double-click-rename.md), [file management](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#file-management).
- **Finder action:** Reveal in Finder uses the guarded context selection or focused File-menu selection. Open directories' contents and reveal files/packages/file links using listed URLs; preserve drafts and surface failures. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#favourites-and-context-menus).
- **Layout:** T19 retains the active browser/document, restores the hidden browser on the right and rejects new hidden-target transfers. Preserve preferred Details width through clamping. Preview/Edit fills the remaining Details height under A31, retaining a usable minimum and scroll access to metadata/long paths. Flag regressions when this scope is implemented. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-11-browser-layout-modes-and-details-sizing.md), [Details contract](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#sidebar-details-and-preview-mode).
- **Restoration:** One remembered active-window configuration serves initial launch, Command-Q relaunch and Dock reopening after all browser windows close. Explicit New Window stays fresh, including with no windows open; activating an existing/miniaturised window must not arm a later restore. Preserve the record on final close and capture it before successful quit. Persist expanded Details separately from its preferred width so Restore Previous Width survives reopening; legacy/invalid expansion defaults to false. Persist the browser ratio by nominal identity only on deliberate divider drags, retaining it through clamping/order changes. Capture actual native frame changes for the remembered owner, restore once even with delayed native attachment and fit valid frames within current screen-visible bounds; missing/invalid geometry leaves defaults. Unit acceptance does not establish full A27 completion. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-16-window-reopen-and-relaunch-restoration.md), [A27](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#multiple-windows-and-remembered-directories).
- **Accessibility:** Record affected native/keyboard/VoiceOver and appearance checks; visual approval or native defaults do not establish an app-wide pass. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-11-native-accessibility-baseline.md).
- **Browser selection:** Keep Mauve controls and dedicated muted browser highlights, with neutral inactive selection, a contrasting outline and readable selected text. Use public row drawing on the owned native table; retain guarded selection, inline rename and native accessibility. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-12-muted-browser-selection.md).
- **UI refinements:** Apply [the accepted additions](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-16-browser-ui-and-preview-improvements.md) as each T20 unit lands: Lucide category icons with fallback and an eye-off badge for hidden metadata while retaining the type icon, alignment and accessible Hidden description; joined layout toggle; searchable name/path favourites popover sized for roughly six to eight typical rows; Name / Size / Modified columns with sortable file metadata sizes and no recursive directory totals; browser-local Quick Look; read-only image/video Details with bounded loading and stopped obsolete playback. Move/Trash omit routine confirmation but retain preflight, shared locks and dirty-editor safeguards. Move name conflicts offer editable numbered Keep Both/Cancel first, with regular-file Replace in a separately reviewed slice. Resolve known batch conflicts before movement; never silently overwrite late collisions or merge folders. Success notifications name the file/action (or batch count), have no info/details action and expire after about five seconds; errors/partial results retain accessible details until dismissal. Existing historical task acceptance does not cover these additions.
- **Intent and evidence:** Meaningful behaviour changes need a current task row and repository evidence, with affected criterion verdicts updated. A PR description alone does not close this gap. Keep progress/results out of specs/plans and unexecuted manual checks pending. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/specs/README.md), [workflow](../agent-paper-trail/skills/panepeek-paper-trail/SKILL.md).
- **Source hygiene:** Keep directory names lowercase except platform-required bundle names. Keep tracking IDs and private paths out of shipped comments; comments explain intent. [Source](../AGENTS.md).
